bug_info.bug_desc: When a PTW access raises ptw_access_exception, the old data-side MMU hardcodes LD_ACCESS_FAULT and reports ptw_bad_paddr in tval. The corrected exception must select ST_ACCESS_FAULT or LD_ACCESS_FAULT according to lsu_is_store_q and report the original virtual address lsu_vaddr_n in tval.
bug_info.fix_hint: In data_interface, handle ptw_access_exception by selecting ST_ACCESS_FAULT for stores and LD_ACCESS_FAULT for loads using lsu_is_store_q. Set tval to the fixed implementation's XLEN-wide zero-extended lsu_vaddr_n, replacing ptw_bad_paddr.
